gecko.visible_surface_material: smooth plastic bottle with paper label
evidence_used: Smooth plastic bottle body suitable for dry adhesive contact
Visually estimated object weight of approximately 600g based on 20 oz ketchup bottle sizing
gecko.calculation_summary: F = W / (2 * mu_effective), estimated mass ~0.6 kg, weight ~6 N, effective gecko dry adhesion friction coefficient ~1.4, F_normal ~ 6 / (2 * 1.4) approx 2.14 N, rounded to 2.2 N
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Mass estimated visually from standard 20 oz ketchup bottle size
Surface assumed clean and dry without residue
Uncertainty in exact payload weight and local contact area
gecko.reasoning_trace: The gecko gripper excels on smooth, clean, nonporous plastic surfaces like this ketchup bottle. The smooth body allows intimate contact for the mushroom-cap dry-adhesive pad. Applying a modest normal force of 2.2 N provides sufficient pre-load for the dry adhesive to generate high shear holding capacity against gravity.

evidence_used: Visually estimated object weight of approximately 600g
silicone.calculation_summary: F = W / (2 * mu_friction), estimated mass ~0.6 kg, weight ~6 N, silicone-plastic friction coefficient ~0.8, F_normal ~ 6 / (2 * 0.8) approx 3.75 N, adjusted down slightly for compliant fin-ray wrap yielding F_normal ~ 3.5 N
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Mass estimated visually from standard product packaging
Friction coefficient assumed based on typical silicone-on-rigid-plastic pairings
Uncertainty in exact grasp friction coefficient
silicone.reasoning_trace: The silicone gripper relies on friction and viscoelastic compliance. While perfectly feasible on the smooth plastic bottle, it requires a higher normal force than the gecko gripper because standard friction coefficients are lower than directional dry-adhesion shear capacities on smooth surfaces.

comparison_evidence: Smooth, nonporous plastic surface of the ketchup bottle
Comparison of dry adhesion versus pure friction holding mechanisms
recommendation_summary: The gecko gripper is recommended because the ketchup bottle presents a clean, smooth, nonporous plastic surface ideal for dry adhesives. This allows the gecko gripper to achieve secure holding with lower normal force (2.2 N) compared to the high-friction silicone gripper (3.5 N), minimizing potential deformation of the plastic container.
